## About
ABC Animal Clinic and Hospital started out as a low cost spay and neuter clinic in Downtown Fort Worth's Medical District. Over the years it grew into a full service veterinary hospital, and it has kept the affordable clinic feel it started with.
Our focus is disease prevention, maintenance and treatment. We also believe informed owners are a pet's first line of defense, so we work to keep you educated and well informed about your pet's health.
We are open Monday through Saturday, and visits are by appointment. Google reviewers rate us 4.4 stars across 290 reviews.

## Services
- Preventative care examinations: Routine checkups to keep your pet healthy and catch problems early. ($25)
- Medical examinations: An exam when your pet is sick, hurt or just not acting right. ($75)
- Spays and neuters: Low cost spay and neuter surgery for cats and dogs.
- Orthopedics and soft tissue surgeries: Beyond spays and neuters, our doctor performs more involved procedures. A pre-surgical exam comes first so you get a detailed estimate.
- Heartworm testing: In-clinic heartworm testing for dogs and cats, plus guidance on staying current with prevention.
- Dental cleanings: Regular cleanings help prevent periodontal disease and keep your pet's teeth longer.
- In-house diagnostics and digital X-rays: Lab work like fecal testing, certain blood work, skin scrapings and eye staining done here while you wait, plus digital imaging to help diagnose illness or injury.
- Medications in stock: A wide range of medications on hand so your pet can start treatment without a second trip.
- Prescription diets and treats: Help with weight and diet plans, with prescription diets and treats available to buy here.
- Behavioral counseling: Advice and guidance to help you understand and train your own pet.
- Boarding: A place for your pets to stay while you are away. Reservations can be booked through our appointment scheduler.

## FAQ
Q: Do you take walk-ins?
A: Office visits are by appointment only. Walk-ins and emergencies are seen with additional charges, so it is best to call ahead.

Q: Is the front door open every day you are open?
A: On Mondays and Saturdays the front door is only open for boarding and medication pick ups. Please call the clinic for refill requests, pick ups and drop offs.

Q: Does my pet need an exam before surgery?
A: Yes. A pre-surgical exam is required before any procedure that involves anesthesia, and it is also how we put together a detailed estimate.

Q: When can I pick my pet up after surgery?
A: Pets are dropped off the evening before surgery, and most can go home the following day between 3:30 PM and 5 PM.
